text: 【雅居乐集团：8月预售金额合计约3.8亿元】9月7日，雅居乐集团在港交所公告，公司及其附属公司（本集团）连同本集团合营公司及联营公司以及由本集团管理并以「雅居乐」品牌销售的房地产项目于2026年8月的预售金额合计为约人民币3.8亿元而对应建筑面积为约4.6万平方米；平均价为每平方米人民币8,234元。
text_en: 【Agile Group: August pre-sales totaled about RMB 380 million】On September 7, Agile Group announced on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange that the pre-sales amount for property projects sold under the "Agile" brand by the company and its subsidiaries (the Group), together with the Group's joint ventures, associates, and managed projects, totaled approximately RMB 380 million in August 2026, with a corresponding floor area of about 46,000 square meters; the average price was RMB 8,234 per square meter.
